# al-Kindi

> A software engineering and visual communication design studio working from interfaces to smart contracts.

al-Kindi is a small, focused studio that designs brands, ships products, and engineers onchain systems. The studio is named after Abu Yusuf Yaʻqub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi, the 9th-century Baghdadi polymath who invented cryptanalysis.

The studio works between Lisbon and Istanbul. Legal entity: Alkindi, Unipessoal LDA.

## Services

- [Smart Contract Development](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): EVM contracts with tight specs, predictable gas, full test coverage.
- [Smart Contract Audits](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Independent security reviews for Solidity and Vyper.
- [Web App Development](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Production web applications with clean architecture.
- [Web Design](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Sites that read clearly and load fast.
- [Digital Product Design](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Interfaces designed end-to-end.
- [Brand & Visual Identity](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Names, marks, type systems, tone of voice.
- [Graphics & Digital Art](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Original illustration, motion, generative work.
- [Technical Advisory](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Architecture reviews, Web3 integration strategy.

## Team
